premises.text: Ordinary website operators lack the performance and security tools internet giants use
premises.evidence_span: if you're trying to run a website today, you're left alone without access to any of these tools

premises.text: One DNS nameserver change puts a site on Cloudflare's global network with no hardware, software, or code changes, in about five minutes, on any stack
premises.evidence_span: all you do is make one change to your domain's name servers, and suddenly you're on the Cloudflare network

premises.text: The network speeds pages (about 30% on average) and blocks spam, attackers, and other malicious traffic
premises.evidence_span: We deliver an average of a 30% decrease in page load times

premises.text: The service is offered at a free price point
premises.evidence_span: there's really only one price point for a service like ours, and that's free

value.text: Anyone with a website gets giant-class speed and security so the web is faster and safer
value.evidence_span: make the web a faster, safer place

causal_links.evidence_span: Your traffic passes through our globally distributed network, and we make sure that the bad guys don't get to you
takes the tools of the biggest service providers and makes them available for anyone with a website online
Cloudflare's got your back, and we won't rest until your site is fast, safe, and secure

notes: Speed and threat-blocking treated as performance package of the same network mechanism but kept as one benefit premise (P3) separate from the DNS onboarding condition (P2). GA rewrite and XSS demos folded as feature cascade of the proxy. Traction metrics and unit-economics boasts excluded per §4.2. Singleton D1/D3: access gap and free pricing independently revisable.
